_comment: BURN-DOWN list for check-dependency-audit.mjs: advisories open in the locked production tree that this repo cannot currently close. An entry is allowed only when there is no published fix to move to, or when a parent pins the vulnerable version and cannot be overridden. Every entry MUST carry a note saying which parent brings the package in, what release it waits on, and the date that was last checked — without it the next reader has to re-derive the whole tree. Reaching a package through a transitive path is not on its own a reason to list it: where a fixed version is published, pin it with pnpm.overrides in ctf/package.json as "package@exact-installed-version": "fixed", so the entry stops matching once the parent moves on. The list may only ever shrink: the gate fails on a new advisory not listed here AND on a listed advisory that no longer applies. Never add an entry to silence the gate; update the dependency instead.

1138808.title: image-size: ICNS parser allows denial of service through an infinite loop
1138808.note: No patched version is published — the advisory reports the fixed range as none, and 2.0.2 (the latest release) is still inside the vulnerable range <=2.0.2. Installed at 1.2.1 through Metro inside Expo (metro 0.83.5 / 0.83.7 / 0.84.4 under packages/mobile), a build-time path several levels down that this repo does not choose a version for; an override has nothing fixed to point at. Remove as soon as image-size ships a fix. Checked 2026-09-14.
